notes: The supplied relative *that* of the articleless attributive participle מַקְשֶׁה was given to the construct's rectum, against the chapter's own treatment of the identical construction in PRO.29.5, PRO.29.14 and PRO.29.20, where rule 41 keeps the relative with the attributive. PRO.29.14 is the exact parallel: *that* and *judgeth* both on שׁוֹפֵט, discontinuous around the interposed adverb. Here *that* and *hardeneth* both belong to מַקְשֶׁה, discontinuous around the rectum's *being often reproved*.
